pressure_definition: median of abs(complex peak pressure) at fixed32 initial positions; sinusoid negative peak has same magnitude, RMS=amplitude/sqrt(2)
fairness: O median matches S; O maximum pressure <=1.01*S maximum; O sum source amplitude squared <= S budget*(1+1e-8); same 20000Pa per-channel exploratory cap. Proxy is not calibrated hardware power.
main_shell: existing production Tu Fig4 manifold; Table2 requested .30/3.2e-9 separately solved, not relabelled as production
radial_gate: direct periodic, weakly compressible, harmonics resolved; complex fundamental and dotV energy table discrepancies each <=5%; new direct convergence <=0.1%
geometry: same F9 cloud: near original; interior chosen largest supported wall gap along mother-segment +Z toward z=0; intermediate half this translation; at most3 regions. All32 finite-radius support tested; relative coordinates/IDs retained.
forecast: 9 straight frozen-velocity probes over10ms; no claim actual integrated prediction
quality: unchanged F2/F6 pair penetration<=.01R; max contact pass<=.1R; wall min gap>=-.01R; wall pass<=.1R

trajectory_plan.early_stop: failed sampled interval retained; no automatic high-pressure continuation after serious contact/wall errors
trajectory_plan.weak_reference: 300Pa S/O may be retained as weak negative comparators at an admitted location; not independently claimed navigation

admission: positive O Z drift; >=50nm predicted in10ms; geometry/CFD/field support and forecast finite-radius legal; radial table gate, valid F2 closure; pressures in [.1,40000] or exact zero

outcome.ACOUSTIC_EFFECT_RESOLVED: positive O-OFF and O-S increments > max(50nm,3*(O step discrepancy+comparator discrepancy)); compare each comparator at half step when needed; quality pass required
outcome.CONTACT_DOMINATED: mean individual cumulative contact path >= absolute O-OFF target increment OR abs(mean signed contact Z)>=50nm; magnitude path is not signed centroid cancellation
outcome.WALL_DOMINATED: abs(mean signed wall Z)>=25% of O-OFF increment OR >50nm

limits: No force multiplier, no hardware/survival validation, no 10kPa trajectory, no new CFD/kWave/database/nearwall hydrodynamics
